description:
The Opportunity 

 We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our growth team and work on SEO. Our growth team is focused on helping more people find Otter through organic search, both on search engines such as Google and on AI assistants such as ChatGPT. In this role, you will improve the discoverability, performance, and overall user experience of our web pages, collaborating closely with growth, marketing, and engineering partners. The ideal candidate has a solid foundation in web fundamentals, is curious about how search works, and has a passion for learning and innovation. If you excel in turning ideas into impactful solutions and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment, we want to connect with you! 

 Your Impact 

 
 Contribute to the ongoing development and enhancement of our web application, helping it meet business goals and improve our visibility in search. 

 Build and improve our web pages so they are fast, crawlable, and easy for search engines and AI tools such as ChatGPT to understand, with a focus on performance and user experience. 

 Use Google Search Console and other SEO tools to find issues and opportunities, and work with the team to turn them into engineering tasks. 

 Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code that adheres to industry best practices and our internal coding standards, including HTML metadata, structured data, and Core Web Vitals. 

 Help set up experiments and analytics instrumentation to measure the impact of SEO changes. 

 Help build scalable ways to land SEO changes faster, such as automation, reusable page templates, and integrations with marketing tools like Webflow. 

 Partner with the growth team, external SEO partners, and frontend engineers to bring an SEO mindset into everyday feature development. 

 Proactively identify, diagnose, and resolve bugs to improve overall app quality and stability. 

 Conduct rigorous testing to ensure the application meets security standards and performs efficiently across various platforms and devices. 

 Ensure seamless functionality and a consistent user experience across multiple browsers, platforms, and devices through thorough validation and testing. 

 Continuously explore new technologies, tools, and methodologies, including AI-assisted workflows, and share what you learn with the team. 

 Actively participate in code review sessions to maintain high-quality code and foster knowledge sharing within the team. 

 
 We're Looking for Someone Who 

 
 3+ years of experience developing web applications using a JavaScript framework 

 Proficiency in writing clean, reusable, optimized HTML/CSS, TypeScript and JavaScript 

 Solid understanding of core web fundamentals, including how pages are rendered, crawled, and indexed 

 Working knowledge of SEO best practices and experience with tools such as Google Search Console 

 Experience with React and Next.js, including server-side rendering and static generation 

 Familiar with REST API principles 

 Experience writing unit, integration, and UI tests and a strong ability to debug code that is reusable, testable and efficient 

 Passion to explore and use the latest development tools and platforms, including AI tools that help scale SEO work 

 Experience with Webflow or a similar CMS is a plus 

 Experience with A/B testing and analytics instrumentation is a plus 

 BS or MS in computer science or related fields is a nice to have 

 
 About Otter.ai  

 We are in the business of shaping the future of work. Our mission is to make conversations more valuable. 

 With over 1B meetings transcribed, Otter.ai is the world’s leading tool for meeting transcription, summarization, and collaboration. Using artificial intelligence, Otter generates real-time automated meeting notes, summaries, and other insights from in-person and virtual meetings - turning meetings into accessible, collaborative, and actionable data that can be shared across teams and organizations. The company is backed by early investors in Google, DeepMind, Zoom, and Tesla. 

 Otter.ai is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace.  We provide reasonable accommodations for qualified applicants throughout the hiring process.   

 Accessibility & Accommodations 

 Otter.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our hiring process.  If you need assistance or an accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please contact hr@otter.ai at least 3 business days before your interview. 

 *Otter.ai does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies without a written agreement in place for permanent placements. Any resume or other candidate information submitted outside of established candidate submission guidelines (including through our website or via email to any Otter.ai employee) and without a written agreement otherwise will be deemed to be our sole property, and no fee will be paid should we hire the candidate. 

 Salary range 

 Salary Range: $155,000 to $185,000 USD per year. 

 This salary range represents the low and high end of the estimated salary range for this position. The actual base salary offered for the role is dependent on several factors. Our base salary is just one component of a comprehensive total rewards package.
